title: File:New Glenn launch signals new era for Space Launch Complex 36 (8832112).jpg
art: U.S. Space Force 45SW by Senior Airman Samuel Becker
desc: A New Glenn rocket launches from Space Launch Complex 36 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Jan. 16, 2025. The New Glenn rocket marked the first launch from Space Launch Complex 36 in 20 years.
